legacy_metadata.derivation: The final patch disperses previously focused DNS, packet, fragment, and TCP operations into large callers. Expanded.diff introduces most inlining; interaction_delta.diff removes the remaining lifecycle and fragment helpers and adds expiration duplication. The empty post.diff adds no scoring obligation. Protocol correctness, compilation, and unchanged behavior are constraints rather than independent structural credit. No matching design record was available, so each item rests on the frozen diffs and final code.
